title: Pocket handoff slate — timeline anchors, SLO snippets, and cost tethering
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Engineers and on-call responders need a lightweight, context-rich surface they can open from alerts or the incident timeline to hand off work quickly. Existing 'incident drawer' feels heavy and forces people to navigate multiple panels; postmortem links, SLO deltas, and immediate cost impact are buried. Goal: design a compact ‘pocket handoff slate’ (slide-over) that anchors to timeline moments, surfaces 3 key SLO snapshots, a short postmortem link with excerpt, and a 'cost tether' showing estimated token/compute spend since alert activation and projected 24h burn if unchanged. This ticket covers prototype, accessibility pass, PM/eng review, and handoff documentation for implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Pocket slate can be opened from alert card and incident timeline anchor
Displays 3 SLO snippets (current value, 24h delta, target) with colored indicator
Includes 1-click copy of the active runbook link and a postmortem anchor link with preview (title + 2-line excerpt)
Cost tether shows current spend since alert + projected 24h burn (CTA to open cost dashboard)
Prototype demonstrates keyboard accessibility and ARIA roles for screen readers
Design handoff includes token-level microcopy and exact spacing/grid tokens for engineering
design_notes: Interaction: slide-over from right, two sizes (compact 360px, expanded 720px) depending on context
Timeline anchor: small stateful marker ties slate to a specific event; selecting different anchors updates SLO snippets and cost tether
SLO snippets: compact chip layout, show metric name, value, delta arrow (+/−), tooltip for query source
Cost tether: teal/orange gradient bar, shows peak token rate and estimate; default uses 95th-percentile of request size; sensitive to customer tier
Postmortem link: preview card with 2-line excerpt and 'Open draft' primary action; if none exists show 'Create postmortem' CTA linked to PR template
Microcopy: keep actions explicit — 'Assign handoff', 'Attach runbook', 'Escalate to on-call rotation'
Accessibility: focus trap inside slate, Esc closes, Enter triggers primary action, ensure 4.5:1 contrast on badges
decisions: Use slide-over rather than modal to preserve underlying timeline context
Limit SLO snippets to three to avoid cognitive load; allow 'view more' to open full SLO dashboard
Cost tether will display projected spend using existing cost service endpoint; rounded to nearest dollar with tooltip showing estimation assumptions
Default slate size will be compact for alerts, expanded for incidents opened from the incident page
tradeoffs: Showing cost estimates in-line increases mental model complexity but reduces time to action for cost-sensitive incidents
Keeping slate compact constrains the amount of metadata visible — we prioritize actionable items (SLO, runbook, postmortem link) over full logs
Anchoring to timeline events requires careful state syncing with backend; we will initially surface read-only context and add edit flows later
